title: Tea, iced, instant, green, pre‑sweetened with sugar

content.title: About
content.content: Iced instant green tea is a convenient beverage that prepares in seconds by adding hot or cold water. The tea is already sweetened with sugar, so no extra sweetener is needed. It retains the light aroma of green tea and a refreshing taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially catechins, which have antioxidant properties.
Instant tea is travel‑friendly: no need to steep leaves.
Pre‑sweetening makes the drink more appealing to children and those who dislike the bitterness of green tea.
In many countries ready‑to‑drink tea mixes are sold in sachets or powder form.
Traditionally, green tea is considered beneficial for metabolism and mental alertness.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Catechins in green tea help neutralize free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Some studies suggest green tea may boost metabolic rate and aid fat oxidation.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: A modest amount of caffeine in green tea enhances alertness without a strong “jolt.”

items.title: Blood sugar regulation
items.content: Polyphenols and polysaccharides may help stabilize post‑meal glucose levels.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Diluted with water, instant tea contributes to daily fluid intake.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Pre‑sweetened tea adds extra sugar, which can be problematic for diabetics or those watching weight.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Although low, caffeine may cause sleep disturbances or jitteriness in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: Rarely, some people may experience an allergic reaction to tea components.

items.title: Product quality
items.content: Low‑cost instant teas may contain additives, flavorings, or preservatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Place 1‑2 sachets (or 1‑2 teaspoons of powder) into 200‑250 ml of hot (80‑90 °C) or cold water, stir until fully dissolved. Optionally add lemon, mint, or ice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the sachet tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
